description: CFS Export File 2012-2022 is a dataset listed in data.bts.gov (Bureau of Transportation Statistics open data), an open data portal of the Bureau of Transportation Statistics under the section "Research and Statistics", published or maintained by US Census Bureau. This is the CFS export file. It describes geographic movements of all exported commodities and includes breakdowns by mode, NAICS, commodity, shipping distance, shipment weight. It includes estimates for tonnage, value, average mile per shipment (Geomiler estimate (2012 and 2017) or GCD (2022)). Coverage: United States (see the dataset for state or local subsets). The portal files it under "Research and Statistics". It has 33 columns, among them VALPCHG, NAICS, GEO_ID, COMM_TTL, DMODE, DMODE_TTL. The portal shows 2025-07-25 as the last data update. Attribution given: US Census Bureau. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is U.S. federal government work, public domain (as labelled on the portal). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, safety and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-bts-data-bts-gov-portal.
